use_when: 测试框架
单元测试
UI测试
性能测试
自动化测试
如何编写ArkTS单元测试用例，使用断言验证业务逻辑的正确性？
如何定义测试套件（suite）和测试用例（spec）来组织测试代码？
如何使用预置动作（beforeEach、afterEach、beforeAll、afterAll）进行测试初始化和清理？
如何通过控件属性（ID、文本、类型等）查找UI控件？
如何模拟用户操作（点击、双击、长按、滑动、拖拽等）进行UI自动化测试？
如何模拟窗口操作（调整大小、移动等）进行UI测试？
如何采集代码段执行耗时、CPU和内存占用等性能数据？
如何测量应用启动时延和页面切换帧率？
如何使用shell命令方式模拟UI操作？
当你的应用需要编写单元测试来验证业务逻辑和代码质量时，你应该使用 Test Kit 的单元测试框架
通过定义测试套件和断言，可以自动化地验证函数返回值、数据处理流程等逻辑的正确性，确保代码在迭代过程中不会引入回归缺陷
当你的应用需要进行 UI 自动化测试或性能基准测试时，你应该使用 Test Kit 的 UI 测试框架和性能测试框架
UI 测试可以模拟用户操作验证界面交互行为是否符合预期，性能测试可以量化应用的启动速度、页面流畅度和资源消耗等关键指标
给 ArkTS 业务方法补充单元测试并校验返回结果 / Add unit tests for ArkTS business methods and verify return values
为登录流程编写端到端 UI 自动化脚本 / Create end-to-end UI automation scripts for the login flow
用 suite 和 spec 拆分并管理测试用例文件 / Organize and manage test cases with suite and spec
在 beforeEach 里初始化测试数据并在 afterEach 清理状态 / Initialize test data in beforeEach and clean up state in afterEach
通过组件 ID、文本和类型定位页面元素做自动化点击 / Locate UI elements by component ID, text, and type for automated taps
模拟点击、滑动、输入文本和拖拽来回归测试页面交互 / Simulate tap, swipe, text input, and drag actions for UI regression testing
编写应用启动耗时和页面切换流畅度的性能测试 / Write performance tests for app startup time and page transition smoothness
统计关键代码路径的执行时间以及 CPU、内存占用 / Measure execution time and CPU and memory usage of critical code paths
批量执行自动化测试并输出测试结果报告 / Run automated tests in batch and generate test result reports
接入 UI 测试脚本验证按钮点击后页面跳转是否正确 / Integrate UI test scripts to verify navigation after button clicks
用 shell 命令驱动界面操作做自动化回归 / Drive UI actions with shell commands for automated regression
测试窗口缩放、移动和多窗口场景下的界面行为 / Test UI behavior under window resize, move, and multi-window scenarios
do_not_use_when: 需求是做事件打点、链路跟踪、崩溃故障定位、健康监控，或使用 HiLog、HiTraceMeter、hdc 等 DFX 工具排查问题；应改用 performance-analysis-kit / The task is about event instrumentation, trace analysis, crash diagnosis, health monitoring, or troubleshooting with DFX tools such as HiLog, HiTraceMeter, and hdc; use performance-analysis-kit instead

需求是处理多语言资源、区域格式适配、文化差异呈现，或进行伪本地化检查；应改用 localization-kit / The requirement is to manage multilingual resources, adapt regional formats and cultural presentation, or run pseudolocalization checks; use localization-kit instead
preconditions: 工程已集成HarmonyOS测试框架并可编译运行ArkTS测试代码 / The project has integrated the HarmonyOS testing framework and can compile and run ArkTS test code
若执行UI自动化测试，目标应用或页面可被测试进程启动并访问 / For UI automation, the target app or page can be launched and accessed by the test process
若采集性能数据，测试设备或模拟器支持相应性能指标采集能力 / For performance collection, the device or emulator supports the required performance metric collection capabilities
inputs: 测试套件与测试用例定义 / test suite and spec definitions
待验证的业务逻辑、页面流程或性能场景 / business logic, UI flows, or performance scenarios to validate
断言条件、控件定位条件或性能指标阈值 / assertion conditions, UI selectors, or performance metric thresholds
outputs: 单元测试用例执行结果（通过、失败、跳过、错误信息） / Unit test case execution results (passed, failed, skipped, error details)
测试套件执行汇总结果 / Test suite execution summary results
断言执行结果与失败堆栈信息 / Assertion results and failure stack traces
UI控件查询返回的Component对象 / Component objects returned by UI component queries
UI窗口查询返回的Window对象 / Window objects returned by UI window queries
UI自动化操作执行结果 / UI automation action execution results
代码段执行耗时数据 / Code block execution time data
CPU占用率采集数据 / CPU usage sampling data
内存占用采集数据 / Memory usage sampling data
应用启动时延测量结果 / Application startup latency measurement results
页面切换帧率数据 / Page transition frame rate data
测试运行日志与结果报告 / Test execution logs and result reports

postconditions.statement: 已新增或修改ArkTS测试代码，包含测试套件或测试用例定义 / ArkTS test code has been added or updated with suite or spec definitions
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify ArkTS test files that define automated tests such as suite/spec or equivalent test case structure?

postconditions.statement: 测试代码包含可执行的验证逻辑，如断言、UI操作步骤或性能采集语句 / The test code includes executable verification logic such as assertions, UI actions, or performance collection statements
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is there concrete verification logic present, such as assert calls, UI interaction steps, or performance measurement code?

postconditions.statement: 测试代码与被测场景建立了明确对应关系，而非仅添加业务实现代码 / The test code is clearly tied to the target scenario rather than merely adding production business code
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits primarily introduce or update test artifacts that target a described scenario, instead of only changing production feature code?
